### Is Anything Too Hard For The Lord?
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/is-anything-too-hard-for-the-lord-girlfriends-in-god-august-19-2013.html
Passage: Genesis 18:14
Points:
- Humans routinely encounter circumstances and needs that cannot be handled through human effort alone.
- Abraham and Sarah faced physical impossibility, being far past the age of bearing children.
- When Sarah overheard the promise and laughed in disbelief, the Lord challenged her doubt by asking if anything was too difficult for Him.
- As El Shaddai, God is entirely sufficient and is never bound by natural laws or human limitations.
- Believers are invited to surrender their doubts and rest in God's ability to fulfill what He has promised.
